statement: The § 1202 exclusion percentage depends on the acquisition date: 50% for qualified small business stock held more than 5 years (general rule); 75% for stock acquired after February 17, 2009 and before September 28, 2010; 100% for stock acquired after September 27, 2010 and on or before the applicable date (July 4, 2025); and for stock acquired after the applicable date and held at least 3 years, an applicable percentage of 50% at 3 years, 75% at 4 years, and 100% at 5 or more years (26 U.S.C. § 1202(a)).
caveat: For 50%/75%-exclusion stock, a portion of the excluded gain is an AMT preference (§ 57(a)(7)) and the taxed portion carries the § 1(h) 28% rate group — neither computed in this repo. Acquisition date and holding period are legal determinations (restricted stock and options follow § 83 timing — rule us-fed.restricted-property-holding-period). Verify current law; the 2025 amendments are recent.
